decision.rationale: Five K3B measurements on 2026-08-14 selected split_passive_protocols. Five post-materialization K5 measurements on 2026-08-15 then confirmed that passive arbor_kernel remains at 3 processes, 0 supervisor children, 0 ETS tables, 3038 ETS words, 0 positive BEAM-memory delta, and 6040-6783 us. Starting explicit arbor_kernel_runtime with optional children gated off deterministically owns three empty subsystem supervisors plus the OAuth pool (4 children), installs the Common redaction filter, and leaves the Signals telemetry bridge detached: 63 processes, 15 tables, 70658 ETS words, 3711488-4575624 bytes, 50152-52479 us, one Logger filter, and zero telemetry handlers. This is not the contracts-only path because passive consumers never start the runtime application. Eager runtime remained at 95 processes, 29 children, 35 tables, 91749-92020 ETS words, 6520194-7763044 bytes, 84697-88802 us, one Logger filter, and one telemetry handler. Baseline callback/child invariants and gated/eager structural counts remain exact; bounded resource ceilings retain headroom for runtime noise. The passive/active split remains accepted and reversible.
